Original designs: user-provided 重卡换电项目设计.zip.
China polygon: https://github.com/johan/world.geo.json/blob/master/countries/CHN.geo.json (public-domain project). Station markers and routes are portfolio demonstration data, not real fleet locations.

2026-11-10: cover-display.png is an original Blender device mockup; screen graphic assembled from approved geography, source indicators and custom SVG charts.
